chart.notes: Hand-built on a 127.0 BPM grid fitted to the drum stem (residual 8 ms). Each bar pattern was chosen from per-bar 16-step onset maps of the demucs stems (kick/clap/bass/vocal/synth) and every tap is snapped to the nearest real onset of its tagged stem within 45 ms. Chorus = halftime kick/snare groove only (one layer, same 2-bar pattern in every chorus); bridge = syncopated trap kick; dance break = four-on-the-floor 8th runs (8-tap and 10-tap runs).

judgment_window_ms.note: +-110 ms accept window around the geometric corner (early taps beyond -110 ms = turn too early => crash into wall; late beyond +110 ms = run off the edge). 8th-note runs here are 236 ms apart so windows never overlap.

grid.note: fitted to gapless-decoded kick/snare onsets (the demucs stems are 25.1 ms late and are re-aligned)

route.rule: forward-only: headings N/E/W, lateral staircase per 2-bar phrase alternating sides, corridor +-12 m

user_taps.snap: tools/charts/omg_user_refine.py (v2: onset-anchored offset + onset-evidence Viterbi on 1/16 slots; v1 omg_user_snap.py)

refine.offset: onset cross-correlation, local (+-10 s, median of 9)

review_withdrawn.why: vocal run: "noth-" (syllable 77.634, raw tap -6 ms) on e

refine.note: all 361 taps re-checked against stem/syllable onsets; same slots as faa6927. The Verse-2 vocal-run reading (77.6-78.6 s) needs a 0.118 s gap and was withdrawn (min gap 0.15 s).
